verdict.rationale: DeepInfra documents deploying your own fine-tuned weights for serving (docs-8/9/18) and separately offers GPU clusters with SSH for training (docs-10), so the pieces to fine-tune-then-serve exist, but there is no evidence of an integrated managed fine-tuning job/dataset-upload API on a supported base model — customers must train themselves on rented GPUs and then manually deploy the resulting weights as a private endpoint. Missing for 10: a first-party fine-tuning job service (upload dataset, select base model, launch job) that outputs directly into the serving catalog, and any hands-on/community confirmation of this end-to-end flow.
